intro.text: Tonight. It has to be tonight. I've been waiting too long already.

hallway_first.text: Thin walls. I used to hear everything through them. Good.

near_father.text: He's always here. Even now, in the middle of the night.

debt_envelope_reaction.text: R. Calloway. That's my name. That's my name on that.

pick_up_savings.text: Three forty. Every dollar I didn't spend in two years.

keypad_clue.text: There's a code on this. I know this house. Think.

timer_start_narration.text: The bus leaves at two. I have thirty seconds to clear this door.

mother_ambient.text: She's still up. She's always still up.

father_ambient.text: Asleep in the same chair. Same as always.
